name: shopsmart-ai
description: ShopSmart AI: Autonomous E-Commerce Assistant & Intelligent Operations Platform

scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const s = spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: 'server', stdio: 'inherit' }); const c = spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: 'client', stdio: 'inherit' }); process.on('SIGINT', () => { s.kill(); c.kill(); process.exit(); });"
